en.t: How truly pitiful this sight was!

units.source_text: 正在此时，惟光走进来了。

en.t: Just then, Koremitsu came walking in.

units.source_text: 他东回西绕，找寻有人声的地方，然而不见一个人影。

en.t: He wound his way here and there, searching for the place where voices could be heard, but he did not see a single person.

units.source_text: 他想：“我往日路过，向里面张望，总不见有人。

en.t: He thought, "Whenever I passed by before and looked inside, I never saw anyone there.

units.source_text: 现在进来一看，果然是无人住的。”

en.t: Now that I have come in and looked, it really is uninhabited."

units.source_text: 正想回去，忽然月光明亮起来，照见一所屋子，

en.t: Just as he was thinking of going back, the moonlight suddenly grew bright and revealed a house,

units.source_text: 两架的格子窗都开着，那帘子正在荡动。

en.t: with both lattice windows open and the curtain swaying.

units.source_text: 找了许久突然发现有人，心中反而觉得有些恐怖。

en.t: After searching for so long, suddenly discovering someone there made him feel somewhat frightened instead.

units.source_text: 但他还是走过去，扬声叫问。

en.t: Even so, he went over and called out loudly to ask.

units.source_text: 但闻里面的人用非常衰老的声音，先咳嗽几声，

en.t: He heard someone inside, in a very aged voice, first cough several times,

units.source_text: 惟光说了自己的姓名，告道：“找一位名叫侍从的姐姐，

en.t: Koremitsu gave his name and said, "I am looking for an elder lady named Jiju,
and I would like to see her for a moment."

units.source_text: 里面答道：“她已经往别处去了。

en.t: From inside came the reply, "She has already gone elsewhere.

units.source_text: 但有一个与她不分彼此的人呢。”

en.t: But there is someone here who is as close to her as herself."

units.source_text: 说这话的人分明年纪已经很老，但这声音却是以前听到过的。

en.t: The person who said this was clearly very old, but the voice was one he had heard before.
